title: Scan {{mode}}
noCamera: The camera is not available. Choose a photo from your gallery instead.

crop.title: Crop receipt
crop.instruction: Drag and zoom so the whole receipt fits the frame.

hint.product: Point at a barcode or label
hint.receipt: Fit the whole receipt in the frame
hint.ingredients: Spread items out on the counter

guide.receipt: Hold the phone about 40 cm above the receipt so its edges touch the guide.
guide.receiptFold: For long receipts, fold where the guide ends (about every 20 items), flip the folded part over, and take the next photo.

detail.product: Adds it to your Pantry with its best-before date.
detail.receipt: Adds every item from your shop in one go.
detail.plate: Lists its ingredients so you can add what you are missing to your shopping list.
detail.ingredients: Adds each loose item on the counter to your Pantry.

sections.empty: No lines were found in this section. Retake it, or take the next photo.
sections.full: You have reached the limit of {{max}} sections. Finish, or retake or delete a section.
sections.queued_one: {{count}} more photo waiting. Press Next photo to crop it.
sections.queued_other: {{count}} more photos waiting. Press Next photo to crop the next one.
sections.tooMany_one: You picked {{selected}} photos, but there is only 1 more section left (the limit is 10). Pick fewer photos.
sections.tooMany_other: You picked {{selected}} photos, but there are only {{count}} more sections left (the limit is 10). Pick fewer photos.
sections.discardConfirm: Leave the scanner? The sections you have taken so far will be lost.
